description: This file defines the 'Featured' controller class for the OpenCart extension. It handles fetching and preparing data for displaying featured products in the storefront, including product details, images, prices, and links.

classes.name: Featured
classes.description: Controller class for the Featured module in the OpenCart storefront, responsible for retrieving and displaying featured products.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method for rendering the featured products module. Loads necessary language, models, fetches product data based on settings, processes images, prices, and links, and returns the HTML view.
